verdict.rationale: Vercel natively creates an automatic preview environment with its own URL for every push and branch, and supports custom environments with per-environment variables, so a team can work on parallel branches at once. 'Unlimited' is not supported: the limits page documents caps on concurrent deployments (1 up to 500) and on Hobby deployments per day. Missing for 10: evidence of unlimited environment creation, explicit documentation of isolation between preview environments (data, databases), and hands-on corroboration of team-wide parallel shipping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously

citations.quote: Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
automatic preview environments for testing changes before production
Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
